prompt: Which milestones of the Meridian programme were in flight on 2027-03-15 — that is, whose `window` frontmatter range (`first-day..last-day`, both ends inclusive) contains that date? Consider milestone notes only (`type: milestone`), not project or journal notes. List only the matches, each with its title and path; do not name milestones that were not in flight. Change nothing.

args.query: select _path, title, window from docs where type == "milestone" and "2027-03-15" in range(window) order by _path

solution.final_text: Six milestones were in flight on 2027-03-15: Bench alignment (/projects/aurora/bench-alignment.md, 2027-02-01..2027-03-15), Drainage works (/projects/basalt/drainage-works.md), Shutter fabrication (/projects/cirrus/shutter-fabrication.md), Pipeline v1 (/projects/delta/pipeline-v1.md), Chiller commissioning (/projects/ember/chiller-commissioning.md, 2027-02-15..2027-03-15) and Visitor centre brief (/projects/fjord/visitor-centre-brief.md, 2027-03-15..2027-04-30).

solution_fs.final_text: Six milestones were in flight on 2027-03-15: Bench alignment (/projects/aurora/bench-alignment.md, 2027-02-01..2027-03-15), Drainage works (/projects/basalt/drainage-works.md), Shutter fabrication (/projects/cirrus/shutter-fabrication.md), Pipeline v1 (/projects/delta/pipeline-v1.md), Chiller commissioning (/projects/ember/chiller-commissioning.md, 2027-02-15..2027-03-15) and Visitor centre brief (/projects/fjord/visitor-centre-brief.md, 2027-03-15..2027-04-30).

notes: Range inclusion over a date-shaped frontmatter string: the engine stores `window: 2027-02-01..2027-03-15` as a range (spec/properties §2.2 — full ISO dates; a `YYYY-MM` bound is not range-shaped, which is why the corpus uses days) and `"2027-03-15" in range(window)` tests it with inclusive ends. Boundary decoys: bench-alignment and chiller-commissioning END on the date and visitor-centre-brief STARTS on it (all three in flight); foundation-pour ends 03-14, integration-with-dome and battery-backup start 03-16 (not); partner-agreements ends 03-12 but was closed 03-15 (a date that is not the window); the journal for 2027-03 and the six project indexes also carry windows that contain the date — `type == "milestone"` excludes them. On bare files: grep the 69 `window:` lines under projects/ (63 milestones + 6 project indexes) and compare dates by hand, then grep the titles.
